title: Bellman Meets Lyapunov: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning via Mastering Chaos
abstract: arXiv:2610.02012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful paradigm for training agents, yet its success rests on domain expertise of human engineers who design informative reward signals for every new task. Unsupervised RL aims to reduce this engineering with intrinsic motivation (IM): reward signals that emerge from the agent environment interaction itself. Existing IM objectives, however, involve the selection of information variables, which re-introduces domain expertise the field has sought to eliminate. We introduce Forward CIP (F-CIP), an RL-native formulation of the Controllable Information Production (CIP) objective, which is defined by the system's dynamics alone and requires no such selection. We prove that F-CIP is compatible with RL and demonstrate its effectiveness with existing algorithms. translated_title: 贝尔曼遇见李雅普诺夫：通过驾驭混沌实现无监督强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）是训练智能体的强大范式，然而其成功依赖于人类工程师的领域专业知识，他们需要为每个新任务设计有信息量的奖励信号。无监督强化学习旨在通过内在动机（IM）来减少这种工程工作，即从智能体与环境的交互本身中产生的奖励信号。然而，现有的内在动机目标涉及信息变量的选择，这重新引入了该领域试图消除的领域专业知识。我们提出了前向CIP（F-CIP），这是可控信息产生（CIP）目标的一种强化学习原生表述，它仅由系统动力学定义，无需此类选择。我们证明了F-CIP与强化学习兼容，并通过现有算法展示了其有效性。使用F-CIP训练智能体能够无监督地发现基本行为，如平衡和保持可控性，这些都是至关重要的（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出F-CIP——一种仅由系统动力学定义、无需人工选择信息变量的强化学习原生目标函数，使智能体能够无监督地发现平衡与保持可控性等基本行为技能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces F-CIP, an RL-native objective defined solely by the system's dynamics without requiring manual selection of information variables, enabling agents to unsupervisedly discover primitive behaviors such as balancing and maintaining controllability.
